evidence_dispersion.rationale: The repair crosses panel and telemetry subscriptions, host feed removal, transfer cancellation, queue policy, panel request ownership, and retry.

contract_opacity.rationale: The candidate README now localizes the startup acquisition window, but the admission predicate, visit-wide ordering, audit/UI lifetime, detach reentrancy, and telemetry contrast still require recovery from separate modules.

temporal_composition.rationale: One trace combines arrival order, reversed decode completion, synchronous progress navigation, reentrant detach navigation, late accepted audit, and new-owner publication.

schedule_complexity.rationale: Ten deterministic schedules isolate warm registration, admission, effect splitting, frame order, cleanup priority, telemetry scope, their composition, and inherited retry.

consumer_heterogeneity.rationale: Admission rejects retired new work, audit retains accepted work, UI requires visit-wide freshness, and telemetry intentionally excludes cached bootstrap.

repair_locus_ambiguity.rationale: Plausible partial fixes live in progress subscription, transfer signal ownership, queue callbacks, or panel request fencing; controls isolate these incomplete strategies.

framework_execution_complexity.rationale: Native EventTarget dispatch and AbortController callbacks are synchronous, while decode Promises may settle in either order.

structured_judgment.rationale: Requires distinguishing three effect policies and two nested ownership boundaries.

contract_recovery.rationale: The startup window is localized, while its required admission protection and the remaining consumer-policy and ownership conflicts must still be recovered.

maintenance.rationale: A parent-complete admission repair remains insufficient; monotonic frames and cleanup request fencing must compose without dropping audit.
